title: Just Use a Jelly Roll Pan
text:
Just Use a Jelly Roll Pan. Okay, so I want to love this ice cream rolling tray and totally gush about it because while it's a great idea about having your own ice cream rolling tray at home, it's so impractical that I just can't love this. I mean, for the price of this rolling tray I can buy tons of ice cream and just have that and not go through all the trouble of making my own and doing all this work for so little. Not only that but you can only use this tray maybe three times before it stops being cold enough to freeze the ingredients to make ice cream. In my opinion, it's just not worth the money or time.
As for the quality of the tray, it's actually really good and holds up super well. It freezes really well and stays cold for a while but not long enough to make more than three ice creams max. The paddles are a nice addition and the kids do love the interaction of playing around and adding different things to their ice cream. However, You can do the same thing with a jelly roll pan and a pan of ice, which I have done before and it works a lot better and for a lot longer.

product_metadata.title: JoyMech Ice Cream Roll Maker Rolled Ice Cream Machine, Sweet Spot Pan, Instant Cold Plate, Ideal for Making Rolled Ice Cream Soft Serve Slushies Frozen Yogurt Sorbet and Gelato (Lavender)
features: [VARIOUS ICE CREAMS]: JoyMech Instant Ice Cream Maker includes everything needed to make delicious homemade ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, fruit sorbet, slushy, and other frozen desserts in minutes. Be creative with your toppings!
[PRE-WORK]: Ice Cream Maker comes with powerful cooling liquid must be completely frozen at 0℉ for more than 12 hours before use.

[EASY TO USE:] Take out Ice cream Maker from Freeze Zone, and pour around 5 fl oz mixed ingredients onto the fast-freeze surface pan, wait for 5 minutes, then scoop and turn until ice cream is formed. Use the scraper to create beautiful, delicious rolled ice cream. Add fruit, nuts, sprinkles or chocolate chips; this ice cream pan is perfect for kids or a fun night in.
[TASTE AND SHARE]: The machine can make about 5 fl oz ice cream each time, and make 3 times in total after freezing. Enough for 3 Kids or 2 Adults to share.
[EASY TO MANAGE]: Unplugged, Hand-washable, Great gift for kids.
